text:
Marco Santini: Planning: SDK v16 rollout — target window Wed 2026-03-18 02:00-03:00 UTC. Hosts: hosted + dedicated. Primary goals: zero-downtime for v1 clients, canary then ramp. TL;DR: canary 5% for 20m, 25% for 20m, full if green.
Priya Rao: Who is on deploy? I can own the canary and smoke checks if Ben covers rollback.
Ben Morales: I can cover rollback + watch infra. Will have rollback runbook ready. Alert if latency spikes > 2x P50.
Alice Nguyen: I'll send client comms draft to #marketing after we lock exact dates. Also will update CHANGELOG + migration guide.
Marco Santini: Assigning: Priya = canary owner, Ben = rollback/sre, Alice = client comms + docs, Chloe = QA smoke tests and API compatibility checks. @Chloe Park you good?
Chloe Park: Yep — I'll run regression suite, quick API contract tests, and do a random sampling of user flows. Smoke checklist: auth, streaming, embeddings, rate-limits. Will post results in thread.
DevEx-bot: Reminder: SDK v16 is feature flagged behind `client.v16 opt-in`. See https://redwood.dev/sdk/releases/v16
Marco Santini: Canary plan: deploy proxy shim and server change to canary pool (5%). Use rollout flag `sdk_v16: true` for 1% then 5%. If errors > 0.5% rollback immediately.
Priya Rao: Smoke commands I'll run:
```
# sanity
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-neo-1","input":"say hi"}'

# embeddings
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"test"}'
```
Chloe Park: I'll validate response shapes and headers. Also check streaming chunk ordering and KV cache hits for repeated prefixes.
Ben Morales: Rollback steps: 1) flip routing to v15 pools 2) scale down v16 3) revert any infra-side config. Note: no DB migration in this release.
Marco Santini: Quick ops checklist: make sure PR #5423 is merged before cut, confirm canary capacity (5% traffic) is provisioned, and notify SRE pager on go/no-go. Code-review pings: @eng-runtime please review.
Alice Nguyen: On it, pinged PR now and added a short migration note in docs.
SRE-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled deploy for 2026-03-18T02:00:00Z to env=prod by user=marco.santini (canary=5%).
Priya Rao: :thumbsup: I will post a short smoke summary after each phase. If all green, we'll do full ramp at +55m.
Marco Santini: Thanks everyone. If anyone finds a blocking client compatibility bug, label `compat:blocker` and @Marco Santini for immediate triage.
Ben Morales: I'll be online during the window and reachable on pager.
Chloe Park: Will upload smoke run logs to the thread and link failed assertions if any.
Marco Santini: Final note — DevEx to send an in-product notice for opt-in clients tomorrow morning once docs landed.
DevEx-bot: Reminder: automated canary metrics will post to #telemetry during rollout.
Priya Rao: Roger. Starting final preflight at 2026-03-17T22:30Z.
